versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill to "Design_Daily" and updated all related references.
- Added a requirements.txt file and installation instructions.
- Introduced a one-click setup wizard via setup.py for easier first-time configuration.
- Revised documentation for clarity and updated output examples.
- Minor structural updates to SKILL.md and file organization for improved usability.

- Updated version to 1.0.1 in SKILL.md.
- No changes to functionality, documentation, or code beyond the version number.

Initial release of the Design Daily Brief skill.

- Provides a daily industry brief tailored for UI/UX designers and product managers.
- Covers topics like AI × design, design engineering, product experience analysis, and design decision logic.
- Supports multi-role configuration for targeted or broad briefs.
- Requires SERPER_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for operation.
- Easy setup and automated daily execution via scheduled tasks.
- Sample outputs and pricing details included for quick onboarding.
